title: 第二十四章 双生同命土水护界第二十三章 暗之本源终敌现世
slug: 星冕天启守护者觉醒录
lines: 漫天倾覆天地的暗黑浓雾依旧沉沉笼罩着整座琉光星冕综合学园，乃至蔓延向远方整座城市的山川旷野。
浓稠冰冷的黑暗戾气无孔不入，蚕食着世间仅存的光明温度，晚风裹挟着刺骨的阴寒，掠过寂静的校舍长廊、葱郁林荫、澄澈湖畔，将大战过后残留的灵力震荡与硝烟余息久久留存。
方才广场之上明暗交锋的激烈激战已然暂时落幕。
夜狩凌朔与朝雾白莲依仗暗樱女王赐予的高阶暗黑本源之力强行拔高战力，看似气势汹汹、碾压十足，可在守护者战队六位守护者默契无间、环环相扣的完美团战体系面前，终究节节受制、处处被压，全程落入下风，狼狈不堪。
暗黑灵力与光明灵光剧烈碰撞炸裂的余波缓缓散尽，空气中明暗两种对立的能量依旧在持续焦灼、缓慢消融。被黑暗浓雾遮蔽的天穹依旧暗沉死寂，看不到半点星月微光，高空悬浮的无边暗影军团静静蛰伏蓄势，无数双猩红嗜血的眼眸冷漠俯瞰下方大地，森冷的杀伐戾气层层积压，让整片天地始终笼罩在风雨欲来、浩劫将至的极致压抑之中。
九重暗雾之巅，暗樱女王一袭黑鎏华服静立虚空，周身翻涌不息的毁灭暗黑本源沉稳内敛，不再是方才肆意肆虐的狂暴姿态。
她默然注视着下方学园广场的残局，漆黑无瞳的眼底没有半分波澜，既无落败的愠怒，亦无观战的趣味，只剩掌控全局、洞悉一切的漠然与冷傲。
于她而言，夜狩凌朔与朝雾白莲本就是随手舍弃、用以试探战力、消耗对手、拖延战局的两枚棋子。
棋子能扛住压制、僵持战局，便是意外收获。
棋子被全面碾压、狼狈落败，亦是意料之中、无关痛痒。
她真正的底牌，是蛰伏多年、无人能敌的自身暗黑本源，是蓄势待发、足以踏平人间光明秩序的全域暗影军团。
方才短短数回合的交锋，已然让她彻底摸清了六位光明守护者当下的真实战力、团战默契、招式短板与防御极限。
所有数据尽数了然于心，所有布局尽数稳步推进。
她不急着大举进攻、踏平光明，她要静待最佳时机，静待守护者们耗尽耐心、耗尽灵力、破绽百出，再一举倾巢而出，吞尽世间所有光明羁绊，碾碎所有守护执念，彻底终结两界存续千年的光明秩序。
良久，暗樱女王薄唇微抿，周身暗黑浓雾缓缓翻涌收拢，庞大无边的暗影威压悄然收敛大半。漫天悬浮的暗影军团随之齐齐敛息蛰伏，隐匿于虚空黑雾之中，静待下一步作战指令。
做完这一切，她的身形缓缓消融在浓稠黑暗深处，悄然隐去踪迹，只留无边暗沉黑雾笼罩天地，将整片人间牢牢禁锢在黑暗阴霾之中。
广场之上，激烈对战彻底停歇，硝烟散尽，风息渐缓。
六道挺拔俊秀的身影并肩伫立在空旷广场中央，一身战斗战衣流光熠熠，各色本源灵力萦绕周身、缓缓流转，明暗对战过后的灵力余温依旧滚烫灼热。
天野凛星身姿挺拔如松，金冰渐变的战衣在昏暗天色中熠熠生辉，高束的马尾利落飒爽，冰蓝色的眼眸澄澈锐利，冷静扫视着四周尚未彻底消散的暗黑戾气。
方才全程带队稳稳压制敌方二人，数次精准预判突袭、强势承接正面攻势、撕裂暗黑灵力壁垒，全程沉稳控局、毫无破绽。
经历此番对战，全队愈发清晰摸清了进阶之后的敌方战力层级，也彻底摸清了暗樱本源加持之下，黑暗力量的侵蚀特性与进攻套路。
终战倒计时已然正式开启，距离全域暗黑总攻、终极宿命对决，已然近在咫尺，再无缓冲余地。
天野凛星缓缓抬手，指尖鎏冰灵光轻轻流转，沉稳有力的嗓音清晰响彻整片空旷广场，安抚全队心绪，同步开启终极战前全面备战部署。
“暗樱女王已然隐去踪迹，暗影军团暂时蛰伏收敛，敌方两轮试探全部结束。”
“如今局势彻底明朗，黑暗浩劫全面降临，终战已然进入最终筹备阶段，我们再无退路、再无侥幸。”
“全员即刻进入最高戒备状态，各司其职、查漏补缺、完善战术、稳固战力，完成所有终极战前筹备。待所有布局圆满落地、全员战力调整至巅峰，我们便正面迎战终极黑暗，彻底清算所有罪孽。”
简短几句话，字字铿锵、句句笃定，瞬间稳住全队军心，将凝重肃穆的战前氛围彻底拉满。
其余五人齐齐颔首应声，眼底战意灼灼、信念坚定，没有半分畏惧迟疑。
历经数次交锋、看透所有阴谋、认清所有黑暗本质，他们早已褪去初入战场的青涩忐忑，淬炼出直面终极浩劫、扛下两界宿命的坚韧与果敢。
藤咲若织静静伫立队长身侧，绛红绯霞渐变的战衣流光婉转，红焰长发随微凉晚风轻轻拂动，草木生机与红莲净火交织的温润灵力平稳流转周身。
她温柔澄澈的眼眸静静望着四周沉寂的学园光景，心底却没有半分松懈。
方才一战，夜狩凌朔与朝雾白莲借助暗樱本源强行暴涨的战力远超预估，招式阴狠暴戾、毫无底线，心性卑劣扭曲、不知悔改，已然彻底沦为黑暗最锋利、最恶毒的爪牙。
这两人一日不除，便一日是光明前路最大的阻碍，会无休止搅乱布局、偷袭骚扰、消耗全队战力、拖累终战节奏。
而暗樱女王隐忍数载、布局深远、心思缜密、掌控一切，真正的实力深不可测、无从窥探，方才仅仅只是冷眼观战、未出一招，便足以让人胆寒忌惮。
前路凶险万重、危机密布，真正的硬仗、真正的宿命厮杀，才刚刚拉开序幕。
正当藤咲若织心绪沉静、凝神思索战前布局与应对之策，周身草木焰火灵力平稳流转、缓缓调息之时，一缕极淡、极轻、几乎隐匿在漫天暗黑戾气之中的气息，猝不及防钻入感知深处。
那气息极其微弱、极其内敛，被周遭汹涌冰冷的黑暗气场层层掩盖，寻常感知根本无从捕捉、无从察觉。
可落在藤咲若织的感知之中，却熟悉到极致、深刻到极致，瞬间穿透层层黑暗屏障，精准叩击在心底最深处、尘封数年的柔软记忆里。
不是人间所有的灵气特质，不是守护者同类的光明本源，亦不是暗樱一族的暗黑戾气。
那是一种极其古老、极其温润、干净纯粹、带着岁月沉淀与故土温度的独特气息，陌生又熟悉，缥缈又真切，萦绕在感知边缘，若即若离、挥之不去。
content_en:
The dark and thick fog that overturned the sky and the earth still shrouded the entire Glazed Star Crown Comprehensive Academy, and even spread to the mountains and wilderness of the entire city in the distance.
The thick, icy darkness was pervasive, eating away at the remaining light and warmth in the world. The night wind carried the biting coldness, passing through the silent corridors of the school building, the lush green trees, and the clear lakeside, leaving the lingering spiritual shock and gunpowder smoke after the war for a long time.
The fierce battle between light and dark in the square just now has come to an end for the time being.
Yokari Lingshuo and Asagiri Bailian relied on the high-level dark origin power bestowed by the Queen of Dark Sakura to forcibly increase their combat power. They seemed to be aggressive and crushing, but in the face of the perfect team battle system of the six guardians of the Guardian Team who had a tacit understanding and interlocking, they were finally restrained and suppressed at every turn. They were at a disadvantage throughout the whole process and were in a state of embarrassment.
The aftermath of the violent collision and explosion of dark spiritual power and bright spiritual light slowly dissipated, and the two opposing energies of light and dark in the air continued to burn and slowly dissolve. The sky covered by thick dark fog is still dark and dead, with no glimmer of stars and moon visible. The boundless shadow army suspended high in the sky is quietly dormant and gathering momentum. Countless pairs of scarlet and bloodthirsty eyes look down at the earth below indifferently. The cold and murderous aura is accumulated layer by layer, making the entire world always shrouded in the ultimate depression of impending storms and impending catastrophes.
On the top of the nine layers of dark mist, the Queen of Dark Sakura stood quietly in the void dressed in black gilded clothes. The source of the destruction and darkness that was constantly surging around her body was calm and restrained, no longer the violent and violent posture just now.
She silently stared at the aftermath of the academy square below. There was no trace of emotion in her dark, pupil-less eyes. There was neither sullenness of defeat nor interest in watching the battle, only the indifference and cold arrogance of controlling the overall situation and understanding everything.
To her, Yekari Lingshuo and Asagiri Bairen were just two chess pieces that were discarded casually to test their fighting strength, consume their opponents, and delay the battle.
If the chess pieces can withstand the suppression and maintain a stalemate, it is an unexpected gain.
It was expected and insignificant that the chess pieces were completely crushed and defeated in an embarrassing manner.
Her real trump card is her own dark origin that has been dormant for many years and is invincible. She is a global shadow army that is ready to go and destroy the bright order of the world.
In just a few rounds of confrontation, she had already fully understood the six guardians of light's true combat power, teamfight understanding, move shortcomings, and defensive limits.
All data are clearly understood, and all plans are being steadily advanced.
She is not in a hurry to launch a large-scale attack and destroy the light. She wants to wait for the best opportunity, wait for the guardians to exhaust their patience, exhaust their spiritual power, and find many flaws, and then rush out in one fell swoop, swallowing up all the fetters of light in the world, crushing all guardian obsessions, and completely ending the light order in the two worlds that has lasted for thousands of years.
For a long time, the Dark Cherry Queen pursed her thin lips slightly, and the thick dark fog around her body slowly surged and gathered, and the huge and boundless shadow pressure quietly subsided for the most part. The shadow army suspended all over the sky then gathered their breath and hunkered down, hiding in the black mist of the void, waiting for the next battle order.
After doing all this, her figure slowly melted into the depths of the thick darkness, quietly disappearing, leaving only the boundless dark mist covering the world, locking the entire world in darkness and haze.
On the square, the fierce battle stopped completely, the smoke cleared, and the wind gradually slowed down.
Six tall and handsome figures stood side by side in the center of the open square, their combat uniforms shining brightly. All kinds of original spiritual powers lingered around them and slowly circulated. The residual heat of the spiritual powers after the light and dark battle was still hot and scorching.
Amano Rinxei's figure is as tall and straight as a pine, his golden ice-gradient battle suit shines in the dim sky, his high ponytail is neat and sassy, ​​his ice blue eyes are clear and sharp, calmly scanning the surroundings for the dark malevolence that has not completely dissipated.
Just now, he led the team to steadily suppress the two enemies throughout the whole process. He accurately predicted several raids, took on the frontal offensive strongly, and tore apart the dark spiritual barrier. He controlled the situation calmly and without any flaws.
After experiencing this battle, the whole team has a clearer understanding of the enemy's combat power level after advancement, and also has a thorough understanding of the corrosive characteristics and offensive routines of dark power under the blessing of Dark Sakura's origin.
The countdown to the final battle has officially begun. The dark general attack on the entire territory and the final fateful showdown are already very close, and there is no buffer left.
Amano Rinxei slowly raised his hand, the icy aura flowing gently from his fingertips, and his steady and powerful voice clearly resounded throughout the empty square, soothing the mood of the whole team and synchronously starting the ultimate pre-war comprehensive preparations.
"The Queen of Dark Sakura has disappeared, the Shadow Army has temporarily gone dormant and converged, and the enemy's two rounds of testing have ended."
"Now that the situation is completely clear, the dark catastrophe is coming, and the final battle has entered the final preparation stage. We have no way out and no luck."
"All members will immediately enter the highest alert state, perform their duties, check for leaks and fill vacancies, improve tactics, stabilize combat capabilities, and complete all final pre-war preparations. Once all arrangements are successfully implemented and all personnel's combat capabilities are adjusted to their peak, we will face the ultimate darkness head-on and completely liquidate all sins."
A few short sentences, sonorous and firm, instantly stabilized the morale of the entire army and completely filled the solemn pre-war atmosphere.
The remaining five people nodded in unison, their eyes burning with fighting spirit and firm belief, without any fear or hesitation.
After several confrontations, seeing through all conspiracies, and recognizing the essence of all darkness, they have long since faded away from the youthful anxiety of entering the battlefield for the first time, and have tempered the tenacity and courage to face the ultimate catastrophe and bear the fate of both worlds.
Fujisaki Wakaori stood quietly beside the captain, her crimson-red battle suit flowing gracefully, her long red hair gently blowing in the cool evening breeze, and the warm spiritual power intertwined with the vitality of the vegetation and the pure fire of the red lotus flowing smoothly around her body.
Her gentle and clear eyes quietly looked at the silent school scene around her, but her heart was not relaxed at all.
In the battle just now, Yekari Lingshuo and Asagiri Bailian used the origin of Dark Sakura to forcibly increase their combat power far beyond their expectations. Their moves were vicious and violent, with no bottom line. Their hearts were despicable, twisted, and unrepentant. They had completely become the sharpest and most vicious minions of darkness.
If these two people are not eliminated, they will become the biggest obstacle to a bright future. They will endlessly disrupt the layout, sneak attacks and harass, consume the entire team's combat power, and slow down the rhythm of the final battle.
The Queen of Dark Sakura has been hiding for several years, has far-reaching plans, meticulous thinking, and controls everything. Her true strength is unfathomable and impossible to spy. Just now she just watched the battle coldly without making a move, which is enough to make people fearful.
The road ahead is dangerous and full of crises. The real tough battle and the real fateful fight have just begun.
Just as Fujisaki Wakaori was calming down, concentrating on the pre-war layout and countermeasures, and the spiritual power of the vegetation and fireworks around him was flowing steadily and slowly adjusting his breath, a very light, very light breath, almost hidden in the dark and violent air that filled the sky, suddenly penetrated into the depths of his perception.
The breath was extremely weak and restrained. It was covered up layer by layer by the turbulent and cold dark aura around it, making it impossible for ordinary senses to capture or detect it.
But when it fell into Fujisaki Wakaori's perception, it was extremely familiar and profound, instantly penetrating through the layers of dark barriers and accurately tapping into the soft memories deep in the heart that had been covered in dust for several years.
It is not the spiritual quality of all human beings, it is not the light origin of the guardians, nor is it the dark viciousness of the Dark Sakura clan.
It is a unique atmosphere that is extremely ancient, extremely warm, clean and pure, with the accumulation of time and the warmth of the homeland. It is strange and familiar, ethereal and real, lingering at the edge of perception, as if it is far away, and lingering.
title_en: Chapter 24: Twins share the same destiny, earth and water protect the world. Chapter 23: The origin of darkness and its final enemy appears.
